title: Re: [Ignite Cadets 13U VA (Fall '26)] Roster and Schedule
description:
Yikes....ok.  Thanks for letting me know.  I really don't have a problem if he just comes to games and pays a prorated amount, but I understand the need to keep the schedule clear and focus on a single sport at some point.
I've loved having Henry and hope he comes back soon!

Aaron
________________________________
From: Esther Scott <esther.evelyn@gmail.com>
Sent: Sunday, August 16, 2026 1:58 PM
To: Aaron <aaront@ignitebaseball.org>
Subject: Re: [Ignite Cadets 13U VA (Fall '26)] Roster and Schedule

Hey Coach Tarr, Henry needs to pass on Fall Cadets - the practices overlap 1:1 with soccer so he'd be missing one or the other each time. He also really wants to prioritize soccer right now so we are going to let him do that for a bit and see how that goes.

Very likely he wants to come back next Spring/Summer - really appreciate the energy you all put in to the kids, he's had a great time with Ignite.

Esther
